stages.instructions: Ask one unresolved question at a time about the hook, values, reaction motion/source and presentation. The roughly 0.5-second repeated reaction is established; do not ask again what shaking means. Idk delegates creative choices, not missing footage.

Pair each text or number state with its meaning against the same reaction loop. Plan readable text holds independently of loop duration; do not require a new facial expression or movement for each state.
Use supplied footage or provide a performance plan for a short repeatable reaction, approximately 0.5 seconds. Yes/no head movement is optional. Do not invent footage or exact source timestamps.

Select and repeat a clean reaction segment while overlaying the changing context states. Inspect loop boundaries; do not force text changes every 0.5 seconds. Resolve whether source audio is muted, retained or replaced so looped audio does not accidentally stutter. Resolve music and effects before adding them. Save a plan if rendering is unavailable.

Check seamless repetition, text readability, intended context shifts, audio continuity and overall ending. Distinguish the reaction loop from whole-video looping. Report checks that were not performed.

note: Workflow operations are design descriptions, not installed commands or an implemented renderer.
